race.description: Nijinsky Standing At Yirribee Stud Mbl Pace
race.comment: MURPHYS REWARD NZ (1) put the writing on the wall when runner-up two runs ago then improved further last time out when he drew deeper and did some work but dug deep to score by a nose at this venue. Should enjoy an economical run from the inside draw so can strike again. CHEEZ (2) made an encouraging return when he came from the second line and finished fourth last start at Melton. Fitter and draws to advantage so is expected to run well. LENNY LINCOLN NZ (3) draws well and has won third-up before so may be ready to show his best form. BIDGEE BABE (4) worked but proved too good three back at West Wyalong and performed well again last time out when third at Albury. Include.
